journal.landing.echoes.body: When tonight rhymes with something you wrote months ago, Journal says it back — the older line itself, its date, and how far back it was: “07 JAN 2026 · seven months ago”. It never interprets. It just remembers with you.
journal.landing.echoes.free: Echoes are automatic and free. Every passage is available in full, with or without Windmill One, and echoes never use your AI allowance. Talk is separate: you start a recording when you want a transcript, and it requires One. One is not on sale yet.
journal.landing.echoes.title: Echoes
journal.landing.how.hearBackCopy: An echo, or the week, says something true — with the count visible. Six of seven days, and the mood and energy of each. It never interprets. It never advises.
journal.landing.how.lookBackCopy: The same canvas, pinched down to a year. Mood is what survives at that height. The days you didn’t write stay gaps — drawn as gaps, counted at nobody.
journal.landing.how.sub: That’s the whole of it — one canvas, and what it gives back.
journal.landing.how.title: Write. Look back. Hear it back.
journal.landing.how.writeCopy: The cursor is already waiting. No prompts, no blank-page ritual — yesterday sits just above, in the same ink, and you keep going from where you are.
journal.landing.lookBack.jul22Line: Clearest day in weeks. I suspect the answer is boring.
journal.landing.lookBack.jul24Line: Everyone else seems further along, and I can’t tell.
journal.landing.lookBack.jul25Line: Long walk with no podcast. The noise dropped a level.
journal.landing.lookBack.legend: Hollow means nothing written. Counted at nobody.
journal.landing.night.earlier: Rain stopped around eight; the street smelled like summer for a minute.
journal.landing.night.echo: Walked back past the bakery for no reason except the light. Some detours are the point.
journal.landing.night.tonight: Took the long way home. The kitchen still smelled of coffee, and the light on the counter was worth the extra ten minutes.
journal.landing.onlyYou.canAnywhere: Write on anything with a browser — install it as an app on your phone.
journal.landing.onlyYou.canSearch: Search by meaning — it runs on your device, and nothing you wrote is sent to answer a query.
journal.landing.onlyYou.shareCopy: There is no share button — not hidden, not disabled. The data model has no share in it.
journal.landing.onlyYou.sub: Journal is not a feeder for the tree — the agent does not read your pages. What this room can and can’t do is structure, not policy.
journal.landing.onlyYou.title: Only you
journal.landing.onlyYou.treeCopy: The agent that helps with your roadmap does not read this room.
journal.landing.onlyYou.voiceCopy: Talk audio is discarded the moment the text lands.
journal.landing.search.note: Search runs on your device — the model, the index and your query. Nothing you write is sent anywhere to answer it.
journal.landing.search.sub: Search by meaning — a feeling finds the passage that never used those words.
journal.landing.search.title: Find the feeling, not the word.
journal.landing.searchSheet.foot: Opening a hit flies the canvas to the spot — neighbours intact, never a detail view.
journal.landing.searchSheet.friLine: Everyone at dinner seemed further along. I kept comparing timelines instead of tasting anything.
journal.landing.searchSheet.thuLine: Made the good soup for no occasion.
journal.landing.why.accountCopy: Roadmap, Journal and Gym — one account across all three, one sign-in, one settings page. No separate sign-ups, no bundle math.
journal.landing.why.everywhereCopy: Phone on the nightstand at 11:40pm, desk on Sunday morning. The canvas is the same canvas wherever you open it.
journal.landing.why.title: Journal is a room, not an app.
journal.landing.write.yesterdayLine: …I could hear what I’d been chewing on all week.
journal.landing.writeTonight.sub: The cursor is already waiting. Tonight’s page can be three lines.
journal.landing.writeTonight.title: Write tonight
